releaseNotes: The repository is now officially Formation. The GitHub repo, root package manifest, README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and CONTRIBUTING.md all identify the founder platform as the product; the old b2c-mobile-business-launch-skill repo URLs redirect to Emuthmartinez/Formation. The engine keeps its own name, skill manifest, and installed-runtime contract unchanged under skill/b2c-mobile-business-launch/, so freshness checks that key on the skill field keep comparing the same identity.

Repository URL references moved with the rename: package.json homepage/repository/bugs, the .github issue templates, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, the source registry's self-referential repo entries, and the remote-manifest example in skill-versioning.md now point at the Formation repo. The expired PR #99 transport workflow (pr99-publisher.yml), which its own note said to remove after v0.66.0, is deleted rather than renamed.
